title: The Chromatic Core
intro_text: The sacred digital heart awaits awakening. Match colored fragments to chromatic sockets and restore full radiance to the world.

levels.name: Prismatic Intro
levels.hint: Colored sockets require exact color resonance. Place the Cyan fragment into the Cyan socket.

levels.name: Duo Resonators
levels.hint: Two sockets with different wavelengths. Deliver Cyan to the Cyan socket and Amber to the Amber socket.

levels.name: Chromatic Bridge
levels.hint: Bridge the gap with the neutral fragment, then deliver the Magenta fragment to its socket.

levels.name: Triad Conduits
levels.hint: Cyan, Amber, and Magenta conduits. Organize the transfer depot to deliver each fragment to its matching socket.

levels.name: The Grand Core
levels.hint: The master finale. Restore all four spectrum conduits: Cyan, Amber, Magenta, and Emerald. Rebuild your escape and restore the world!
